name: deepwiki-generator
description: Generate comprehensive DeepWiki documentation using autonomous AI agents.

languageModelTools.name: deepwiki-generator_createDeepWiki
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyzes the current workspace and generates comprehensive DeepWiki documentation using autonomous sub-agents. It orchestrates a 9-stage pipeline (L1-L9) to plan, analyze, and document the codebase. Required parameter: fileEditToolName (the file edit tool name for subagents). Optional parameters: mermaidValidatorToolName (Mermaid syntax validator tool - if provided, subagents will validate all Mermaid diagrams), outputPath (defaults to .deepwiki), startFromStage (resume from a specific stage).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Generate DeepWiki documentation for the current workspace.

outputPath.description: Optional output directory path for the generated DeepWiki. Defaults to '.deepwiki' in workspace root.

fileEditToolName.description: Optional name of the file edit tool available to subagents in this environment (used only for prompt instructions), e.g. 'apply_patch' or 'replace_string_in_file'. If omitted, the extension will auto-detect when possible.

mermaidValidatorToolName.description: Optional name of the Mermaid syntax validator tool available to subagents, e.g. 'mcp__mermaid__validate'. If provided, prompts will instruct subagents to validate Mermaid diagrams using this tool. If omitted, no Mermaid validation instructions are included.

startFromStage.description: Optional resume/start stage for the pipeline. If set (e.g., 'L4'), earlier stages are skipped and required artifacts under outputPath must already exist. Use 'auto' to let an AI subagent analyze existing artifacts and determine the optimal resume point.
